How the Leads Work

  • Local focus – Leads are filtered to the Atlanta metro region, ensuring you connect with nearby customers.
  • No upfront account setup – You can start receiving leads immediately after signing up; there’s no lengthy onboarding process.
  • Simple pricing – After the three complimentary leads, you pay $40 only for leads you accept, so you only spend on prospects that fit your business.

Why Choose CaratBase for Atlanta Gold Buyer Leads

Frequently Asked Questions
